text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having run out of first-aid bandages, I 
stopped by the infirmary, and……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
She's out at the moment. But as a health 
committee member, I can take care of any 
minor matters! Is there something I can 
help you with today?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I can whip that up right away! Please 
give me just a moment!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—So, when it comes to non-elastic bandages 
used for sprains and fractures, there's a 
recommended way to wrap them. First, the 
anchor...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She brought over a massive stack of 
bandages and shared a wealth of knowledge, 
from the basics to advanced techniques 
even a Trainer wouldn't know.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoops... I'm sorry, I ended up talking 
too much!
choice_data_list: No, I actually learned a whole lot!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It happened to be my area of expertise, so 
I got all fired up wanting to help out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
My legs haven't always been the strongest. 
So I've been studying and trying to learn 
on my own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fragile legs... a heavy handicap for an 
Umamusume. Yet her expression was bright, 
showing she had never given up and kept 
working tirelessly.
choice_data_list:
You were really persistent in memorizing 
that.

You really worked hard to memorize all 
that, huh?
I'll do my best to memorize it too!
I'll do my best to memorize it too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Maybe it just came 
naturally to you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because when you fall, the only option is 
to stand right back up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, having a strong heart is so 
important, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If anything comes up, you can always talk 
to me. I'll do everything I can to help!
